logoUsageHint: Shown on invoices, reports, and client emails. Square images work best.
changeLogoHint: Click the logo or use Change to crop a different image.
logoFileHint: JPG, PNG, GIF, or HEIC. You can crop and zoom before saving.
cropLogoHint: Drag to reposition and use zoom so your logo fills the circle cleanly.
messagingUsageHint: Used counts every company on this account, including messages still queued. This company shows messages the provider accepted in this period.
roleAdminDescription: Same access as the owner, except they cannot delete the company.
roleOfficeDescription: Can see all clients, routes, invoices, and estimates, add clients, and move routes.
roleTechnicianDescription: Sees only their own clients and routes. Can clean pools and do repairs.
roleCleanerDescription: Sees only their own clients and routes. Cleans pools.
createInvoicesSaveAsDraft: Create invoices and save as draft
createInvoicesOnlyDoNotSendInvoice: Create invoices only and do not send invoice
createInvoicesOnlyDoNotSendEmail: Create invoices only and do not send e-mail
setYourDefaultsHint: We pre-filled recommended settings for most pool companies. Review them below — you can always change these later in company settings.
freePlanDisabledHint: Some email and filter options stay disabled until you upgrade your plan.
clientEmailsDescription: Choose when clients (and your office) get notified by email.
officeCcHint: Receives a copy of service-related emails so your team stays in the loop.
sendServiceReportAfterPoolCleaning: Send service report after Pool Cleaning
sendServiceReportAfterPoolCleaningDescri: When a Pool Cleaning visit is completed, email the client a service report
notifySkippedVisit: Notify clients when a visit is skipped
notifySkippedVisitDescription: For example weather, locked gate, unsecured pet, or too much debris
notifyFilterCleaningDescription: Email the client when filter cleaning work is finished
reportEmailIncludeTitle: What to include in the service report email
reportEmailIncludeHint: On the Free plan only photos can be attached. Upgrade your plan to include readings, chemicals, notes, and checklist.
waterReadingsDescription: Measurements taken at the pool, like chlorine, pH, and alkalinity
chemicalsUsedDescription: Products added during the visit, like chlorine tabs or acid
photosDescription: Service photos taken during the visit
technicianNotesDescription: Written notes the technician left about the visit
checklistDescription: Completed checklist items from the visit
servicePhotosDescription: Rules for the default before and after photos on Pool Cleaning visits.
beforeServiceHelper: Usually a snapshot of the pool when the tech arrives
afterServiceHelper: Usually a snapshot of the pool when the tech finishes
requiredOnEveryVisitDescription: Technician must take this photo before finishing the service
allowGalleryUploadDescription: Technician can pick an existing photo instead of using the camera
attachToClientEmailDescription: Include this photo when service report emails are sent
filterMaintenanceDescription: How often filters should be cleaned or replaced, and whether photos are required.
requireFilterPhotosDescription: Technicians must photograph filter cleaning or replacement before marking it done
schedulingDescription: Control whether services can be completed ahead of schedule.
allowAnticipatedServicesDescription: Let technicians complete a visit before its scheduled date when it makes sense
